pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions during active pullback wicks; only pyramid upon confirmation of trend resumption via volume expansion.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require order execution to clear a 3-ATR volatility buffer away from obvious institutional liquidity pools and round-number psychological barriers.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation once profit crosses the $5.00 threshold to lock in gains and force runs toward the $15-$30+ target band.
